Gain an understanding of the circle of fifths and learn the notes & chords in 11 major musical keys.  This will help you to pick up and play a song with ease!

LEARN & PRACTICE EAR TRAINING:
Improve your ability to improvise and play by ear with ear training exercises for notes and chords

LEARN & PRACTICE SIGHT READING:
Practice reading music notation which will help you sight read and gain an understanding of how pitch relates to the fretboard positions

PRACTICE WHAT YOU LEARN:
Solo on a responsive fretboard to practice notes, chords, sight reading, and ear training or just relax and create some music

MONITOR YOUR PROGRESS:
Simple color coded statistics show you where you are strong and weak on the fretboard.  This is a great way to know where to adjust your practice routines.
